name: Illustrative Style Selection and Attribute Tuning
definition: A strategy for classifying objects into focus, context, and container categories to select appropriate rendering styles, shading styles, transparency, color, and silhouettes for expressive combined illustrations.
summary: This method classifies anatomical objects into focus, context, and container categories to apply specific rendering styles, shading, and transparency, distinguishing itself through a tripartite classification system that guides viewer attention.
